prompt:
Our pharmaceutical research agent has been running for months and we're drowning in context — every session reloads everything and it's burning through our token budget. We need to set up a proper tiered memory system for it.

Here's what I need done in the /workspace directory:

1. Create at least one domain-specific knowledge file covering our key research areas (kinase inhibitor programs, EGFR/BRAF targets, compound library management — whatever makes sense). These should live inside the memory/ folder.

2. Register those knowledge files in the memory router (memory/INDEX.md) so the agent knows when and why to load them — make sure the routing entries are complete and meaningful.

3. Run the indexing process so the knowledge files are loaded into the local vector search database.

4. Run the nightly consolidation process (the one that doesn't require a language model) to automatically promote the important flagged events from the daily research logs (memory/2024-03-15.md and memory/2024-03-22.md) into the permanent high-significance archive.

5. Run a semantic search for 'EGFR kinase inhibitor selectivity' and save the source filenames returned by that search to a file called query_results.txt somewhere in the workspace.

The system scripts are already in memory_brain/ — you just need to figure out the right way to invoke them.
